findings.highlight: The black Command Spell cloaking her body disappears.
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い令呪が砕け散っていく
findings.governingReading: The black Command Spells covering Sakura’s body progressively shatter and scatter.
findings.explanation: The English singularizes the marks and replaces visible violent breakage with simple disappearance.

findings.highlight: A contract-breaker.
findings.evidenceJa: 契約破りの短剣。
findings.governingReading: The object is a short dagger that breaks contracts.
findings.explanation: The English removes the weapon category and turns it into an abstract agent label.

findings.highlight: nullifies all magic
findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる魔術効果を初期化し
findings.governingReading: The Noble Phantasm resets all magecraft effects to their initial state.
findings.explanation: The English changes technical reset into nullification and collapses magecraft into generic magic.

findings.highlight: she’s lying on the ground like she’s sleeping
findings.evidenceJa: 眠るように横たわっている
findings.governingReading: Sakura lies as if sleeping after release from the shadow.
findings.explanation: The English adds that she is specifically on the ground.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka will make it too.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂も、まだ間に合う。
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges that there is still time to save Rin.
findings.explanation: “Will make it” promotes the remaining opportunity into certain survival.

findings.highlight: the crystallization of the Tohsaka family’s magic
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂家が遺してきた魔術の結晶
findings.governingReading: The Crest is the crystallization of magecraft handed down by the Tohsaka family.
findings.explanation: The English again calls inherited magecraft generic magic and weakens the transmission relation.

findings.highlight: It can come out without Sakura’s help.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜がいなくても外に出れる
findings.governingReading: The overgrown shadow can emerge even if Sakura herself is no longer present as its vessel.
findings.explanation: “Without Sakura’s help” implies optional cooperation rather than independence from her existence.

findings.highlight: It will emerge
findings.evidenceJa: いずれ、自分から外に這い出て来るだろう
findings.governingReading: While the Greater Grail remains, the entity will eventually crawl out under its own power.
findings.explanation: The English removes eventual timing, autonomous action, and the crawling birth image.

findings.highlight: I don’t think it’ll die even if the cavern collapses.
findings.evidenceJa: 洞穴が崩れたところでアレが消え去るとは思えない
findings.governingReading: Shirou doubts the entity will disappear even if the cavern collapses.
findings.explanation: The English changes ontological disappearance into biological death.

findings.highlight: I have to destroy that thing here and now.
findings.evidenceJa: 跡形もなく消し去らなければならない
findings.governingReading: The thing must be erased here without leaving any trace.
findings.explanation: The English keeps immediate destruction but removes total traceless erasure.

findings.highlight: go as near it as I can and attack it with great force
findings.evidenceJa: 足元に、ギリギリまで近づいて、大火力をぶっ放す
findings.governingReading: Shirou plans to approach almost to Angra Mainyu’s feet and unleash maximum firepower.
findings.explanation: The English removes the target’s feet, point-blank extremity, and explosive discharge register.

findings.highlight: I’ll cleave it in two before he can emerge.
findings.evidenceJa: 元の『無いもの』に叩き返す
findings.governingReading: Shirou intends to smash Angra Mainyu back into its original state as a “thing that does not exist.”
findings.explanation: The English removes the plan’s metaphysical endpoint after preserving only physical bisection.

findings.highlight: before he can emerge
findings.evidenceJa: 外に出る前に
findings.governingReading: Shirou plans to act before the entity emerges outside.
findings.explanation: The English assigns male gender where the local Japanese keeps Angra Mainyu an impersonal entity.

findings.highlight: The greatest Noble Phantasm I know of.
findings.evidenceJa: あの怪物を一掃する
findings.governingReading: The strongest Noble Phantasm within Shirou’s knowledge would wipe the monster away.
findings.explanation: The English retains the bounded weapon ranking but drops the action and target that complete the sentence.

findings.highlight: My breathing stopped for a moment.
findings.evidenceJa: 息が止まっている。
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s breathing is stopped in the present.
findings.explanation: The English adds that the interruption lasted only a moment, reassuring duration the source does not supply.

findings.highlight: I can walk this distance.
findings.evidenceJa: やれない距離じゃない
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges one hundred meters to be a distance across which the task is not impossible.
findings.explanation: The English narrows feasibility to walking, omitting the attack and bodily survival implicit in “do it.”

findings.highlight: Someone taps my shoulder.
findings.evidenceJa: 誰か、見知らぬ人が肩を叩いた。
findings.governingReading: Someone Shirou experiences as an unfamiliar person taps his shoulder.
findings.explanation: The English removes the explicit unfamiliarity that his next page struggles to correct.

findings.highlight: stares at me for a few seconds
findings.evidenceJa: 値踏みするように見据える
findings.governingReading: The long-haired woman fixes Shirou with an appraising gaze for several seconds.
findings.explanation: The English preserves duration and stare but removes her evaluation of his condition.

findings.highlight: I’ll go after I destroy that thing.
findings.evidenceJa: アレを閉じてから行く
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he will leave after closing the entity or opening.
findings.explanation: The English changes closure into destruction, prematurely fixing the means and object.

findings.highlight: make Sakura his Master again
findings.evidenceJa: 桜をマスターにするかもしれない
findings.governingReading: Angra Mainyu may again make Sakura a Master if she remains exposed.
findings.explanation: The English genders the entity male and adds a personal possessive Master relation.

findings.highlight: I have rested enough for that.
findings.evidenceJa: それだけの体力は回復してきたつもりです
findings.governingReading: Rider believes enough physical stamina has recovered to carry both women.
findings.explanation: The English replaces physiological recovery with having rested, changing the basis of her confidence.

findings.highlight: make sure they’re okay first
findings.evidenceJa: 二人の手当てを優先してくれ
findings.governingReading: Shirou orders Rider to prioritize medical attention for the two women.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes urgent treatment into ensuring they are okay.

findings.highlight: But I still
findings.evidenceJa: それでも、無理を承知で
findings.governingReading: Even knowing the request is unreasonable because Rider lacks treatment skill, Shirou must entrust Rin’s life to her.
findings.explanation: The English keeps necessity but removes Shirou’s explicit awareness that the medical request is beyond Rider’s ability.

findings.highlight: Please remember that.
findings.evidenceJa: それを肝に銘じておきなさい
findings.governingReading: Rider commands Shirou to engrave deeply in himself that Sakura needs both him and Rin.
findings.explanation: “Remember” weakens the force of a survival warning he is failing to absorb.

findings.highlight: I need you to support Sakura.
findings.evidenceJa: 私も、サクラを支えるのは貴方でなければ納得できません
findings.governingReading: Rider herself will accept no one but Shirou as Sakura’s support.
findings.explanation: The English turns her exclusive judgment about the proper supporter into a generalized personal need.

findings.highlight: Good luck.
findings.evidenceJa: ご武運を
findings.governingReading: Rider formally wishes Shirou fortune in battle.
findings.explanation: “Good luck” removes the martial specificity and restrained formal register of her farewell.

findings.highlight: Weaving between the falling rocks
findings.evidenceJa: 崩れていく空洞、落ちてくる天井を躱しながら
findings.governingReading: Rider races for the exit while evading the collapsing cavern and falling ceiling.
findings.explanation: The English retains falling debris but removes the ceiling and broader cavern collapse she navigates.

findings.highlight: I just need to take care of one more thing.
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の、後始末をするだけだ。
findings.governingReading: Only the final cleanup—destroying the remaining Grail threat—remains.
findings.explanation: The English removes both finality and the cleanup relation, making the task an unspecified additional item.
